in_hebrew.name: Marrilee
in_hebrew.meaning: שם נוצרי שפירושו Mary like the sea
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Marrilee הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. Derived from Mary and lee, meaning 'Mary of the sea'. In Christian tradition, Mary is the mother of Jesus and an important spiritual figure.

in_greek.name: Marrilee
in_greek.meaning: Χριστιανικό όνομα που σημαίνει Mary like the sea
in_greek.long_meaning: Marrilee είναι ένα χριστιανικό όνομα με βαθιά πνευματική σημασία στον χριστιανικό πολιτισμό. Derived from Mary and lee, meaning 'Mary of the sea'. In Christian tradition, Mary is the mother of Jesus and an important spiritual figure.

in_latin.name: Marrilee
in_latin.meaning: Nomen Christianum quod significat Mary like the sea
in_latin.long_meaning: Marrilee est nomen Christianum cum profunda significatione spirituali in cultura Christiana. Derived from Mary and lee, meaning 'Mary of the sea'. In Christian tradition, Mary is the mother of Jesus and an important spiritual figure.
